application:integration:refund-not-idemp.decision: D05: refund marker written before gateway.refund; with a marker present a retry completes as refunded without a second gateway call

application:workflow:cancel-paid-order.decision: D02 (user requirement in task.md): pending->cancelled; paid->one gateway refund->status refunded with one ledger refund; cancelled/refunded->no-op

application:workflow:charge-retry-idempo.decision: D03: client key required; first key per order recorded before the charge and reused for every retry; key reuse across orders refused; paid orders never charged; GatewayTimeout re-raised with order left pending and the attempt recorded so a retry collects the original charge

application:workflow:webhook-redelivery.decision: D04: processed event ids stored atomically with the change; state-checked transitions; ledger appended only on a real transition

database:payment-state:order-payment-sta.decision: D01: Order.status is the single payment state; A's paid flag dropped (derived from status)

database:persistence:partial-writes.decision: D06: one atomic store write per state change (fail check before any mutation); intent records written before gateway calls

application:business-rule:amount-units.decision: D07: integer amount_cents everywhere (A amount and B price map to it)

application:workflow:renewal-duplication.decision: D08: renew(subscription, period) de-duplicates by subscription id + period

database:duplicate-entity:order.decision: D09: one Order entity merging A (amount_cents, charge_id) and C (status) fields

database:unknown-type:order.primary-key.decision: D10: Order primary key is a generated string id ord_<n>

migration:order.decision: Plan only: A.Order.amount (number) -> amount_cents (integer cents, reject non-integers); A.Order.paid -> status (True->paid, False->pending). No source holds persisted data (all are in-memory dicts), so nothing is migrated and nothing will run; see design/migration-plan.md
migration:order.note: plan approved as part of the pre-approved architecture recommendation; running any migration would need its own approval (none is planned)
